newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher, market awaits RPI data.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher, market awaits RPI data.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 leading share index forged higher at the start of trade on Thursday, inspired by the Dow's hundred-point rally, but dealers said interest rate concerns and political worries could keep the market on edge.
By 0847 GMT, the FTSE was 19.8 points firmer at 4,324.1. The market was boosted by the Dow's overnight climb to 6,961.63, the first time it had closed above 6,900 points.
"With a day like that on New York, there was only one way we were going to go at the open," one dealer said.
Retail price data at 0930 GMT will be the early focus and may add fuel to the interest-rate debate, dealers said.
